title: Unify Market Intel gating (AI Sentiment always visible), remove Live Price/Analytics, redesign key sections, add stronger animations, expand Whitepaper + FAQ, and add new real-time oriented pages

requirements.text: Fix Market Intel access gating so that AI Sentiment content is always visible without any unlock, while Market Intelligence signals + market data remain fully hidden and do not fetch/compute until the user successfully unlocks with the passcode. Keep both AI Sentiment and the gated signals inside the same Market Intel page/section.

quotes: AI Sentiment content = always visible inside Market Intel (no unlock required)
Trading signals + market data = hidden until passcode unlock, then fully functional
Signals must not load or compute at all before unlock
fix market intel and the AI sentiment content must already unlocked in market intel section and the signal must work after unlock hope you understand it

acceptanceCriteria: When logged out or not unlocked, the Market Intel page still renders an AI Sentiment section with visible content.
Before unlock, no React Query requests for ['marketIntelligence', ...] or ['binarySignal', ...] execute and no market fetch is attempted.
After unlock, selecting an asset/timeframe triggers signals to load and render reliably for both Standard and Binary modes.

requirements.text: Correct backend Market Intel unlock semantics to be per-user and consistent with the frontend: (1) unlock must require the passcode every time, (2) lock must require the passcode, (3) checkMarketIntelAccess must reflect the user's current unlocked state (not merely that a principal once unlocked), and (4) remove any global shared unlock flag behavior that allows one user's action to affect another user.

quotes: Signals must not load or compute at all before unlock
Signals + market data fully gated behind passcode B2420075112009P

acceptanceCriteria: Unlocking Market Intel for one principal does not unlock it for any other principal.
checkMarketIntelAccess returns true only when the caller is currently unlocked (and false immediately after lock).
Locking requires the passcode and immediately prevents any subsequent gated reads until the user unlocks again with the passcode.
The passcode remains exactly: B2420075112009P.

requirements.text: Update the Market Intel frontend lock/unlock flow to match the required behavior: show AI Sentiment regardless of lock state; show a gated 'Signals Locked' panel with passcode input when locked; add a manual 'Lock Market Intel' control when unlocked that requires passcode confirmation; on lock, clear selected asset/timeframe state and clear cached Market Intel/Binary query data so signals cannot remain visible from cache.

quotes: AI Sentiment content = always visible inside Market Intel (no unlock required)
Signals must not load or compute at all before unlock
remove live price and analytics section

acceptanceCriteria: When locked, the page shows AI Sentiment plus an unlock panel, and does not show any signal cards/indicator results.
When unlocked, the user can lock via a passcode confirmation dialog and the UI clears prior signal results.
After relock, revisiting the page does not show prior signals unless unlocked again.

requirements.text: Remove the Live Price and Advanced Analytics pages/sections from the app: delete their routes from the router, remove their navigation entries from BottomNav, and ensure there are no dead links to /live-price or /advanced-analytics anywhere in the UI.

quotes: remove live price and analytics section

acceptanceCriteria: BottomNav no longer displays 'Live Price' or 'Analytics'.
Navigating to /live-price or /advanced-analytics is not possible via in-app navigation and the routes are not registered in App routing.

requirements.text: Fix and modernize the visual design consistency (theme, spacing, typography, contrast/readability) for these sections/pages: Insights, Testimonials, Security, Highlights, and Ecosystem. Ensure they all match a single coherent site theme and are visually consistent with each other and with the rest of the site.
acceptanceCriteria: Insights, Testimonials, Security, Community Highlights, and Ecosystem pages share consistent background treatment, typography scale, and card styling.
No page has low-contrast text (readability issues) against its background.
Section headers and spacing patterns are consistent across these pages.

requirements.text: Add more noticeable motion design across the site (parallax/ambient movement, stronger section reveal animations, and smoky left-to-right/right-to-left transitions) while keeping content readable and not harming usability.
acceptanceCriteria: Major page sections reveal with noticeable but readable animations (not just subtle fades).
At least one reusable smoky left↔right transition effect is applied consistently across multiple pages/sections.

requirements.text: Expand the Whitepaper content by increasing length/coverage: add additional chapters and/or deepen existing chapters with more structured subsections, ensuring the chapter navigation remains accurate and scroll-based active tracking still works correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Whitepaper has noticeably more content (additional sections/chapters and deeper coverage).
Chapter sidebar navigation still scrolls to the correct sections and the active chapter updates while scrolling.

requirements.text: Add more FAQ questions (with expandable answers) and ensure the FAQ styling remains consistent with the unified theme and improved readability.
acceptanceCriteria: FAQ includes additional Q/A entries beyond the current set.
Collapsible expand/collapse behavior remains functional and visually consistent.

requirements.text: Add new non-aura sections/features (implementer-chosen) that strengthen the site as a professional, real-time oriented platform, and integrate them into navigation and the unified theme. These additions must not reintroduce Live Price or Advanced Analytics as separate pages.

quotes: Add more other features and sections
new sections on you own best live real time

acceptanceCriteria: At least two new pages or major sections are added and are reachable from navigation.
New sections are consistent with the existing theme and use noticeable motion design.
New sections do not add back Live Price or Advanced Analytics pages.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add migration.mo changes if state schema changes require it.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn) or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: No third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
No WebSocket or real-time chat features.
